title: Mission
description: The frontmatter of a mission (M): one epic piece of work the commander assigns, with a goal and a statement of what done looks like. Filed by identifier and name, M001-cockpit-setup.md.

type.description: the word Mission, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: this mission's identifier, M and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

status.description: where the mission stands: planned, in_progress, or closed, which only the commander declares

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

branch.description: the git branch the mission is flown on

assigned_by.description: who opened the mission, normally the commander

context.description: the identifiers this mission came out of, a bracketed list, such as the spark or dossier behind it

generates.description: the identifiers of the work this mission has thrown off, a bracketed list of dispatches, dossiers and requests
